extracted.intended_audience: Members and staff of the Interagency Working Group (IWG) and related SMC structure; producing agencies and analysts who prepare IWG papers
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative rules and standards for scheduling IWG meetings, placing items on the agenda, assigning production responsibility, preparing and approving working papers and reports, dissemination controls, acting-chair designation, and use of standard case forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Time and Place of Meeting
rubrics_metrics.description: The Executive Secretary, with the advice and consent of the Chairman, shall arrange for meetings of IWG and shall notify members in advance of the time, place and agenda for such meetings, which normally will be held each week on Thursday morning at 10:00 a.m.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meetings are scheduled by the Executive Secretary in consultation with the Chairman; normal cadence is weekly Thursday 10:00 a.m.; members must be notified in advance of time/place/agenda.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Agenda
rubrics_metrics.description: No substantive matter should be placed on the agenda for action unless the member agencies have had notice at least two working days in advance of the meeting at which the subject is to be discussed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members should notify the IWG secretariat three full working days in advance (when possible) of matters to be placed on the agenda. When an agenda item involves presentation of a paper, distribution should allow at least one week for review prior to IWG consideration. The Chairman may suspend these requirements at his discretion. It is suggested that the submitting agency transmit papers in photo or other reproducible form for reproduction and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Assignment of Responsibility for IWG Production
rubrics_metrics.description: When the IWG determines that an intelligence study should be produced in response to a request, the Chairman shall assign responsibility, with the consent of the agency concerned, for its preparation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assignment may be made to a subgroup of IWG or to a member agency. The Chairman may alternatively refer the problem to the Executive Committee of JBAB or other interdepartmental group if beyond IWG competence or responsibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Subgroups — composition and chairing
rubrics_metrics.description: When subgroups of IWG are constituted, non-members may be invited to participate. IWG members shall be appointed (whenever practicable) to chair such subgroups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a non-member is appointed chair, the IWG member representing the agency from which the chairman is appointed is responsible to keep the IWG advised of subgroup activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: D.1 Definition of "An IWG report"
rubrics_metrics.description: "An IWG report" denotes any intelligence document which the IWG has approved as such with the consent of the originating agency or agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: D.2 Submission of studies as working papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Studies prepared for IWG shall be submitted through the Executive Secretary as working papers for review prior to their dissemination as IWG reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Approval for release of papers must have been obtained from source agencies by the producing agency. A statement that such approval has been obtained will be appended to each draft working paper submitted to the Executive Secretary, who will assign an appropriate number to the working paper and effect its distribution. (See also Section IV, paras. A and B of Attachment I.)

rubrics_metrics.name: D.3 Working papers treated as drafts and dissemination limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Working papers submitted to IWG shall be considered to remain in draft until acted upon by IWG and shall not be disseminated outside the Group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception: IWG members may make limited dissemination within their own agencies on a 'need to know' basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: D.4 Member review and response requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: When working papers are submitted to IWG for review prior to release, a copy shall be furnished to each member, who shall be requested to indicate to the Executive Secretary within a time limit determined by the Chairman his concurrence, dissent, reservation, or proposal to furnish additional intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members must respond within the time limit set by the Chairman with one of the specified positions to facilitate consensus-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: D.5 Preparation of a consensus report
rubrics_metrics.description: The preparing agency will make every effort to produce a report which represents the intelligence consensus of those member agencies having an interest in the matter or whose intelligence has been used by the preparing agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To achieve consensus the Chairman may appoint a subgroup to review the problem and prepare or arrange for preparation of a revised paper to be submitted for IWG review. Following IWG approval, the finished report may be forwarded with any remaining dissents, comments, or additional intelligence to the requestor and given authorized IWG dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: D.6 Forwarding reports despite unresolved dissents
rubrics_metrics.description: If time, or the nature of the dissents, does not permit development of a concurred report representing the intelligence consensus, the report may be forwarded with any dissents, comments, or additional intelligence to the requestor and given authorized IWG dissemination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports may still be disseminated with appended dissenting views or supplemental intelligence when consensus cannot be achieved in time.

rubrics_metrics.name: E. Designation of Acting Chairman
rubrics_metrics.description: It is the responsibility of the Chairman, in the event of his absence from duty, to designate an Acting Chairman for the period of absence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Acting Chairman shall have the powers of the Chairman during the period of designation.

rubrics_metrics.name: F. Approval for Release of Material for Use in IWG Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: When material from intelligence agencies is incorporated in an IWG paper, IWG members shall serve (whenever practicable) as the channel through which approval for release of such material may be obtained from the producing agency, subgroup or individual analyst.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IWG members should coordinate release approvals so that producing agencies' permissions are obtained before inclusion of material in IWG papers.

rubrics_metrics.name: G. Use of IWG Case Forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for intelligence production, reports of apparent violations of Free World economic defense controls, and collection requirements relative to such apparent violations shall be submitted on the standard IWG case form and made the subject of IWG cases, in the discretion of the Chairman.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an IWG case is established, each member shall secure from his agency and submit to the Executive Secretary (or other designated official) all available pertinent information or intelligence, or recommendations for collection, as required, for retention or for information and return.
